_comment: Customize this for your room. Matching is case-insensitive and whole-word/phrase (so 'assumption' won't match 'ass'). This starter list is intentionally mild/generic — add or remove phrases as your room's rules require. Do not put self-harm or crisis-related phrases here: an automated 'stop spamming' warning is the wrong response to someone in genuine distress, and this bot is not built to handle that.
